urdu transliteration: Jab mujhe aap ke qatil ne hai maara baba
english translation text: When your killer struck me, O father,

urdu transliteration: Har tamachay pe Sakina ne, pukaara baba
english translation text:
With every slap, Sakina cried out,
"O father!"

urdu transliteration:
Mujhe baalon se pakar kar hai, tamaachay maaray
Mene sar shimr se maanga jo, tumhaara baba

Woh jo durr aap ne tofay me, mujhe bakshe the
Unko be dardi se zaalim ne, utaara baba
english translation text:
The earrings that you had gifted to me,
The cruel tyrant tore them away mercilessly,
O father.

urdu transliteration:
Aap ke seenay pe araam, se sonay waali
Sokay ab khaak pe karti hai, guzaara baba
english translation text:
I, who used to sleep peacefully upon your chest,
Now spend my nights sleeping upon the dust,
O father.

urdu transliteration:
Nokay neza pe usse dekhoon, to dekhoon kaisay 
Mera Asghar tha mujhe jaanse, bhi pyaara baba
english translation text:
How can I bear to look at him upon the tip of a spear?
My Asghar was dearer to me than life itself,
O father.

urdu transliteration:
Ye sada kabr se masooma, kiyaa ay Mohsin 
Saath qayim ke chalay aana, dobaara baba
english translation text:
From her grave the innocent one calls out,
Says Mohsin:
"Come again with the Qa'im, O father."
